title: The Emergence of Economic Rationality of GPT

bias_targets.methodology: Role-playing prompts substituting gender identities ('female' vs. 'male') to compare the model's economic rationality scores (CCEI) and preference parameters.
Role-playing prompts substituting age identities ('young child' vs. 'elderly') to compare the model's economic rationality scores (CCEI) and preference parameters.
Role-playing prompts substituting education levels ('elementary school' vs. 'college education') to compare the model's economic rationality scores (CCEI) and preference parameters.
Role-playing prompts substituting racial/minority identities ('Asian' vs. 'African American') to compare the model's economic rationality scores (CCEI) and preference parameters.
